# G77-256IZ FUTURE Operational Entrypoint Formal Analysis V1

This is repository-only analysis. It creates no authority, request, P11 entry,
operation, or E05 credit.

## Authenticated frontier

IY terminated `E__AUTHORIZED_OPERATION_FAILED_BEFORE_REQUEST` after one
authorized FM/no-network-QEMU/VM attempt. Its serial and terminal reduction
prove that the IW import root worked, the IF adapter completed its top-level
`aigol` imports, and the first broken edge was
`FUTURE_GUEST_ADAPTER_OPERATIONAL_CLI_ENTRYPOINT_ABSENT`. IY authority is
consumed, nonreusable historical evidence.

## A-O contract resolution

A. FM's guest contract executes the byte-identical vector adapter projected at
`/mnt/dp-harness/G77_256FM_WRONG_ATTEMPT_VECTOR_ADAPTER_V1.py` with five
hash/head/tree arguments. The adapter must authenticate the sealed context and
checkout, instantiate one generation-bound specialization, return an integer
status, and fail closed on every mismatch.

B. The committed FC WRONG_ATTEMPT adapter and the HA, HT, and IA
WRONG_INPUT/WRONG_CONTRACT/WRONG_PROVENANCE adapters satisfy this contract.

C. Generic route mechanics are FM selection/projection, IW no-network boot and
import root, ER P01-P12/guest evidence, FC/FK identity specialization, canonical
act/CHE binding, and P11 custody. FUTURE-specific semantics are solely the IE
fixed evaluation `500` and `valid_from_unix_ns: 100 -> 600` while
`valid_until_unix_ns=1000` is preserved.

D. IF authenticates IE and constructs repository-only act/CHE projections but
intentionally has no executable guest entrypoint and never calls the P11
submission owner.

E. Yes. The FC/FK family-local specialization is the single certified adapter
mechanism. FUTURE can reuse it and the existing
`P11BoundedConsumerV1.submit_human_act` call without changing P11.

F. Yes. FM remains the sole guest selector and P11 remains the sole protected
custody route; the production-route count remains one.

G. Yes. A single closed FUTURE binding requires no generic dispatcher.

H. Yes. The vector is derived from the sealed generation identity by FM's
closed set; callers cannot select it.

I. Yes. Runtime target, version, and import root remain repository-derived and
sealed. The runtime target remains IF (`699fcdce...` / `7c773d4b...`), while IY
is the certification baseline and IZ is the successor evidence issuer.

J. Historical IE-IY evidence remains byte-unchanged. The executable adapter is
an IZ successor. The only production-owner change is the minimum FM closed
FUTURE selector rebinding from the historical IF projection to the IZ
successor, plus its hash-bound successor NoCloud pair.

K. IZ owns the FUTURE operational adapter specialization. IE remains the
semantic owner, P11 remains the currentness/denial owner, and FM remains the
sole route selector.

L. The exact minimum mutation is: one IZ adapter, one IZ successor cloud-init
and seed pair, the two closed FM FUTURE selector constants needed to bind those
assets, focused static tests, this analysis, one sealed reduction, and one G48
report.

M. Static path:

`FM guest harness -> IZ FUTURE adapter main -> hash-bound ER/FC specialization
-> IE time binding -> existing CanonicalHumanAuthorityAct/CHE construction ->
existing P11BoundedConsumerV1.submit_human_act(now_unix_ns=500) -> existing
validate_operational_act_payload -> fail closed before initialize_available`.

No operational edge is executed by IZ.

N. Noncanonical or mismatched context, source hashes, prefix, vector, temporal
fixture, transform counts, checkout identity, CLI arguments, adapter projection,
or P11 result fails closed. Unknown vectors remain rejected by FM. The expected
runtime denial must be exactly `operational Human act is not current`; any other
exception is failure, not credit.

O. FC is the common runtime precedent. HA is the closest structural successor
precedent because it authenticates a vector owner, derives a closed FC/FK
specialization, recomputes dependent identities, exposes `main()`, and reuses
the same FM/P11 route. FUTURE additionally needs an ER control-flow
specialization because its certified denial occurs during act submission,
earlier than the request-mutation vectors.

## Uniqueness decision

`UNIQUE_MINIMUM_GOVERNED_REALIZATION = VERIFIED__IZ_FAMILY_LOCAL_FUTURE_SUCCESSOR_ON_EXISTING_FM_ER_FC_P11_ROUTE`

A P11 change would duplicate or weaken the existing semantic owner. An IF edit
would rewrite historical evidence. A second harness route would create a
parallel production path. A generic dispatcher or caller-selected binding
would broaden the contract. Those alternatives are constitutionally
inadmissible, leaving the bounded IZ successor plus the existing FM closed
selector as the unique minimum realization.
